project.name: Inspecto — Anomaly Detection (optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL add-on module (ANOMALY-DETECTION-1, add-on anomalyDetection, Professional and above per D-AD4): the anomaly-model component kind (AnomalyModel, validated fail closed by AnomalyKindValidator, with the reserved anomaly_scores_ output stores), the pure scorer (AnomalyScorer: robust z, weighted RMS, 0-100 per D-AD6) and the anomaly.score Job Type (AnomalyScoreJobType / AnomalyScoreEvaluator) writing anomaly_scores_{model} and _latest with ownership markers. Baseline statistics live in the pure package com.gamma.anomaly.baseline. Package com.gamma.anomaly.
Shares the output-marker writer (com.gamma.alert.ScoreOutputDirs), EvidenceMasker and the entity-key masking helper with inspecto-scoring through the engine (D-AD5) - it does NOT depend on inspecto-scoring. THIN: no shade. Built only under the edition-professional / -enterprise / -preview profiles.
